text: Meeting deadlines is a skill that requires careful planning and discipline. Good time management starts with breaking a large project into smaller, manageable tasks and setting mini-deadlines for each one. It is also important to prioritize your work, tackling the most urgent or difficult tasks first when your energy is high. Sometimes, you must practice scope management, which means learning to say no to extra requests that could derail your original plan. Finally, do not forget communication. If you foresee a delay, inform your boss or team early. Keeping everyone updated builds trust and gives you room to adjust the schedule or get help, making the final deadline much less stressful.
